exposure: Lithium exposure during the first trimester
outcome: Neonatal readmission to hospital within 28 days of birth
Congenital malformations (major malformations and major cardiac malformations)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 22,124 liveborn singletons born between 1997 and 2015 to mothers with a mood disorder or who had received lithium during pregnancy, from six international cohorts (Denmark, Sweden, Ontario/Canada, Netherlands, UK, USA).
finding: Lithium exposure was associated with an increased risk for neonatal readmission within 28 days of birth and, when occurring during the first trimester, was associated with an increased risk of major malformations.
country: Denmark, Sweden, Canada (Ontario), Netherlands, UK, USA
followup_time: 28 days after birth for neonatal readmission
